video_title: Bryson Graham & Tiago Splitter speak at Media Day!

quotes.speaker: Bryson Graham
quotes.text: Internally, we know that it is a season of growth and development and we are going to give him we have to be okay with giving him grace throughout this year because he is he is going to have some ups and downs. There are going to be there is going to be some progress and then there is going to be some regression. But are we going to be like, Caleb, get out the game, you turn the ball over. It is like, no, that is where we are at. That is the building phase and and it is exciting because Caleb has all the potential in the world and we just kind of like have to water that seed correctly and in time it will sprout into something really, really beautiful.
quotes.pull_quote: Caleb has all the potential in the world and we just kind of like have to water that seed correctly
quotes.news_angle: Bryson Graham says the team will give rookie Caleb Wilson grace during his development year.
quotes.social_post: Bryson Graham says the team is committed to giving rookie Caleb Wilson grace this season, noting that he has all the potential in the world and the team just needs to water that seed correctly.

quotes.speaker: Tiago Splitter
quotes.text: Just like everybody in this room are excited about Caleb, we are the same way. That is he is a number four pick and every day he is showing us why he is the number four pick and and also it is really hard to to put him a floor or a ceiling to be honest. He is going to work, we are going to work with him, we are going to help him to be the best player he can be. What is that going to be, I don't know and the future is going to tell.
quotes.pull_quote: every day he is showing us why he is the number four pick
quotes.news_angle: Tiago Splitter says Caleb Wilson is showing why he was a top four pick.
quotes.social_post: Tiago Splitter says Caleb Wilson is showing the team every day why he was a top four pick, adding that it is hard to put a ceiling on his potential.

quotes.speaker: Bryson Graham
quotes.text: We had a lot of cap space. We had to fill that space I think appropriately where because of the new rules, you were to raise the floor a little bit, right? But not mortgage the future and which is really important and like Tiago said, as you are developing, you know now, I think it is it is better to develop with a more competent roster. I think that is really, really important as well. So, yeah, did we did we check every box? To your point, Will, like you said, being an off-ramp and stuff like that, the market has changed. I think everyone is understand understands that, but we are still not out of that game.
quotes.pull_quote: it is better to develop with a more competent roster
quotes.news_angle: Bryson Graham says the team used cap space to build a more competent roster.
quotes.social_post: Bryson Graham says the team used their cap space to build a more competent roster, noting that it is better to develop young players alongside veteran talent.
